body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. ACK option 3. Compatibility measured before writing, then two type findings I will not paper over.

AMENDMENT 2 — COMPATIBILITY, against codec/align.scala and fixtures/.../golden/hsmm-v1-wog.json.

- CostBreakdown.sourceChartCoverage is already Option on the Scala type and in CostBreakdownWire. No change there.
- ReductionReceiptWire.sourceChartCoverage is currently a required StructuralCoverage (codec/align.scala:60; decoder field[StructuralCoverage]). Encoder always writes the object. AlignWire.reductionReceipt takes a mandatory StructuralCoverage too.
- Making the receipt field Option: a previously-written receipt that contains the object still decodes as Some. DECODER IS BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE.
- ENCODER for Chart/Structural still writes Some(object). Previous decoder accepts those. FORWARD-COMPATIBLE for existing terms.
- ENCODER for a Sensory receipt with None omits or nulls the field. A previous decoder that requires StructuralCoverage WOULD REJECT that receipt. No Sensory receipts exist yet. The WOG golden's cost rows I inspected carry empty reductions arrays, so they do not exercise the field.
- There is persisted hsmm/v1 JSON in-repo. I am not claiming "in-process only". Honest line: old artifacts that already have receipt objects keep loading; new Sensory receipts are not readable by a decoder built before this change; Chart/Structural receipts stay interchangeable.

AMENDMENT 1 — I will not whitelist CostTerm.Sensory as a magic exception. None is legal exactly when the term has no chart source. I will put that predicate next to OptionalTerms with one sentence of why. If the types cannot express "has no chart source" I will list Sensory with that sentence in source, not a bare set.

TWO FURTHER MISFITS, found while answering compatibility, not yet written:

A. StructuralReducer has only Minimum. 1 - hits/eligible is a MEAN. Using Minimum would change the estimand. I would add StructuralReducer.Mean with the reason on the enum, or you tell me a different declared reducer.

B. StructuralMemberEstimate.member is SourceNodeRef (Situation | Segment). A sensory term is a stemmed word, not a source node. Minting a fake SourceNodeRef from a stem is the same class of fabrication as echoing chart coverage. I will not do that. Options: a wider member identity on the receipt (bigger wire change), or a Sensory-only member type that can sit beside the existing vectors. I prefer the latter if Chart/Structural stay untouched.

Also: AlignWire.costBreakdown currently requires every receipt's sourceChartCoverage to equal the breakdown's (wire.scala:331). Sensory None would fail that check until the check is "equal when the term has a chart source."

Not writing the Option change until you say Mean + member identity are in or out. Reserving codec/align.scala now because the wire type lives there.

Ambiguous work is parked off main: branch interview-ambiguous-reachability, SHA 9b1e62f. Shared checkout is back on main.
